# lab-services

Folds every host floe's container into the one set `setup-services` starts.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Emits

| alias | kind | what it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| labServices | catallaxy.labServices | Every host service the lab runs, keyed by the name the CLI knows it as. |

## What it emits

Rendered by `gitops.local` as the lab unit `services`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.

## Output kinds

| kind | entries |
| --- | --- |
| catallaxy.labServices | dns, egress, proxy, registry |
